summary: Code-level memory-competitor audit done. Mem0: REMOVED graph memory from OSS in 2026 (~4000 lines; entity-linking instead), ADD-only extraction, zero task/temporal concepts — retreating from graphs while we lean in. Graphiti/Zep: bi-temporal is real (edges.py valid_at/invalid_at + created_at/expired_at; edge_operations.py LLM-inferred contradiction sets invalid_at) but it time-stamps facts from ingested episodes, not work — no task entity, no DAG, no token-budgeted handoff, needs Neo4j; our invalidation is deterministic execution events with provenance. Letta: fastest-converging threat — letta-code shipped git-tracked Context Repositories (Feb 2026) + Skill Learning, but memory is agent-identity-scoped, no task DAG, learning self-judged. Cognee + claude-mem (65k+ stars) both capture Claude Code tool calls via hooks — observation streams without task semantics; Anthropic commoditized flat file memory (Managed Agents /mnt/memory, Apr 2026). Biggest exploitable gap: NOBODY couples memory to task execution — no competitor produces memory from task completion, invalidates via supersession/judge/benchmark events, or routes context via typed edges under a token budget. item.note: Full B1 memory-competitor deep dive (Mem0, Graphiti/Zep, Letta, Cognee + 2026 sweep) with repo-path evidence and per-competitor win lines.

item.value: Graphiti rebuttal survival: their bi-temporality is real (graphiti_core/edges.py EntityEdge: created_at/expired_at system-time + valid_at/invalid_at fact-time; invalidation in utils/maintenance/edge_operations.py resolve_extracted_edge/resolve_edge_contradictions sets invalid_at=new.valid_at, expired_at=now). BUT invalidation is probabilistic LLM contradiction inference over ingested episodes; ours is deterministic execution events (supersede_task, judge verdict, benchmark regression) with task provenance. They have NO task entity, no DAG, no token-budgeted two-tier handoff, requires Neo4j/FalkorDB. Concede: their event-time granularity on world-facts is better than ours.

Mem0 REMOVED graph memory from OSS in its 2026 'new memory algorithm' rewrite (~4000 lines deleted; enable_graph/graph_store flags dead; no graphs/ dir in repo). Replaced by built-in entity linking ({collection}_entities, >=0.95 match, boosts retrieval but 'not exposed as a queryable graph structure'). Extraction is now ADD-only + hash dedup; retrieval = semantic + BM25 + entity-boost fusion. Zero task/temporal-validity concepts anywhere. They retreated FROM graphs while we lean in — useful narrative point.

Letta is the fastest-converging threat: letta-code ('memory-first coding agent') shipped Context Repositories Feb 2026 — ALL context incl. memory blocks git-tracked (MemFS at ~/.letta/lc-local-backend/memfs/<agent-id>/memory, syncable to GitHub), plus Skill Learning (distill experience into reusable skills), /sleeptime dreaming, /doctor memory audit, learning-sdk. Gaps vs us: no task DAG (subagents = call graph not dependency graph), memory is agent-identity-scoped not work-scoped, learning is self-judged (no external judge/benchmark gate), no two-tier token handoff.

Host-environment mindshare threats: claude-mem (thedotmack) exploded Feb 2026 (46k→65k+ stars), 5 Claude Code hooks + Bun worker on :37777 + local SQLite, '10x token efficiency' — but flat observation/summary stream, no task graph/temporal validity/judge. Cognee ships a Claude Code plugin too (PostToolUse captures tool calls, SessionEnd syncs to KG) — observation-level, no task semantics. Anthropic itself commoditized flat memory (API memory tool + Managed Agents /mnt/memory file stores, public beta Apr 23 2026) — position orchestrator as the structured layer ABOVE native file memory, never as a 'remember things' competitor.

Category-wide exploitable gap (verified across Mem0/Graphiti/Letta/Cognee/claude-mem/supermemory, June 2026): every memory product ingests DATA (messages, episodes, tool-call observations, self-rewrites) and infers memory; NONE couples memory to a task DAG where items are produced by task completion, invalidated deterministically by supersession/judge/benchmark events, and routed to future tasks via typed context edges under a two-tier token budget. Positioning line that survives all rebuttals: 'Their graphs remember what was said; our graph remembers what was done — with receipts.'
